fact: The Niger Digital Day national caravan, launched at its Diffa leg on 3 September 2026 with about 60 participants, trains young people in digital tools and trades and is to tour all eight regions of Niger.

Governor of Tahoua launched a free digital training for 140 young people on 25 August 2026 as part of the Niger Digital Day national tour, sponsored by the Minister of Communication and New Information Technologies.
Niger Digital Day's focal point says it trained more than 300 young people in 6 regions in 2025 and will cover all 8 regions this year.

The Niger Digital Day 2026 caravan, launched in Maradi on 18 August 2026 by the region's delegated administrator, is a youth digital-skills programme the organisers say will run in all eight regions and reach over 800 young people.

An Algerie Telecom delegation visited ESCEP in Niamey on 9 September 2026 to study rapid deployment of a digital Skills Center, under a July 2026 partnership accord, to train people in ICT, cybersecurity, AI and robotics.
